seo_title: QR Ticketing API Integration: Sell Without Commissions
seo_desc: Do you pay 10% to event platforms? We integrate a Serverless Cloud API to generate and scan your own QR tickets with no per-sale commissions.
author_pitch: I have seen entrepreneurs and event organizers lose thousands of euros a month in abusive commissions from ticketing platforms. I build independent Cloud infrastructures so you can generate, send, and validate your own QR codes while retaining 100% of your profits.
title: Cloud Ticketing API Integration: Issue QR Tickets and Escape Abusive Commissions
body:
Do you lose up to 15% of every sale by paying commissions to third-party event platforms?

For freelancers and small leisure businesses (escape rooms, tour guides, academies, or local theaters), relying on external portals to sell tickets is a financial drain. Even if they sell out the venue, margins disappear due to the processing fees for each issued ticket. Furthermore, the platform keeps the customer data, preventing you from building loyalty for future events.

The trap of External Event Portals

Using mass-market solutions seems easy at first, but it makes you a prisoner who rents their own customer base and surrenders a large part of their profitability. Selling your own capacity should not involve paying a technological toll for every attendee.

Our solution: Cloud Ticketing and QR Code API

At LANZA ESTUDIO, we design your own ticketing engine using a Serverless API architecture. We connect your direct payment gateway with a cloud generator that issues electronic tickets and sends them automatically to your customers, keeping the entire infrastructure under your absolute control.

  1. Cryptographic QR Generation: The API creates unique, encrypted codes in real-time after each payment, which are impossible for resellers to forge or duplicate.
  2. Automated Cloud Delivery: We deliver the digital ticket instantly via email or WhatsApp in PDF format, or adapted for Apple Wallet and Google Pay.
  3. Proprietary Validation System: We provide you with a lightweight web dashboard so your team can scan and validate entries at the door using the camera of any standard mobile phone.
  4. B2C Data Sovereignty: 100% of the buyers' information (emails, phone numbers, habits) is saved directly into your own CRM for your future marketing campaigns.

The Real Impact on Your Leisure Business

  • Total margin recovery: Save thousands of euros annually by eliminating per-ticket management fees; you only bear the basic cost of the banking gateway.
  • Total cash flow control: Receive sales money instantly into your bank account, without waiting for the third-party platform to settle weeks after the event.
  • Technological independence: Project a highly professional image with white-label tickets and an access control system on par with major production companies.
